-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity to Factorial API.

list-employees.name: list-employees
list-employees.description: List all employees in the company with optional filters (active status, team, location, etc.).

get-employee.name: get-employee
get-employee.description: Get detailed information about a specific employee by ID.

list-teams.name: list-teams
list-teams.description: List all teams in the company.

list-leaves.name: list-leaves
list-leaves.description: List time-off requests (leaves) with optional filters (employee, status, date range, etc.).

params.status: Filter by status: pending, approved, rejected

get-leave.name: get-leave
get-leave.description: Get detailed information about a specific time-off request by ID.

create-leave.name: create-leave
create-leave.description: Create a new time-off request (vacation, sick leave, etc.).

params.employeeId: The employee ID requesting the leave
params.leaveTypeId: The leave type ID (e.g., vacation, sick leave)
params.halfDayStart: Whether the start day is a half day
params.halfDayFinish: Whether the end day is a half day
params.comment: Optional comment or reason for the leave

list-leave-types.name: list-leave-types
list-leave-types.description: List all available leave types (vacation, sick leave, etc.).

list-shifts.name: list-shifts
list-shifts.description: List all attendance shifts with optional filters.

list-worked-times.name: list-worked-times
list-worked-times.description: List worked time records for employees.

list-overtime-requests.name: list-overtime-requests
list-overtime-requests.description: List overtime requests with optional filters.

params.status: Filter by status: pending, approved, rejected

approve-overtime.name: approve-overtime
approve-overtime.description: Approve an overtime request by ID.

params.overtimeRequestId: The overtime request ID to approve

reject-overtime.name: reject-overtime
reject-overtime.description: Reject an overtime request by ID.

params.overtimeRequestId: The overtime request ID to reject

list-documents.name: list-documents
list-documents.description: List all company documents with optional filters.

get-document.name: get-document
get-document.description: Get detailed information about a specific document by ID.

list-locations.name: list-locations
list-locations.description: List all company work locations and offices.

name: Factorial
description: Factorial HR — manage employees, time off, attendance, payroll, documents, contracts and teams via Factorial API with OAuth2
